crib.name: the Crib Sheet
crib.does: Shows the English beside each neuralese word you have glossed

steadyKeel.name: Steady Keel
steadyKeel.does: In a race, leans the Solar Skiff back toward the racing line while you are not steering
steadyKeel.switch: world/raceway/keel.js (keelSteer, asked by courier/skiff/skiff.js with A / D let go)
steadyKeel.number: at most 0.4 of a full steer, aimed 14 m down the line; nothing once on it

steadyHand.name: Steady Hand
steadyHand.does: Draws the psygun's aim gently onto a target near the reticle
steadyHand.number: a pull of the aim toward a target within 3 degrees of the reticle, at most 30% a frame

wideBore.name: Wide Bore
wideBore.does: Makes the psygun's shots a third wider

thickWalls.name: Last Straw
thickWalls.does: Marks the last 35 Lachryma of your pool: below the mark, one more full blow will crack you
thickWalls.switch: the Lachryma ring (Calissa's: lit while game.knacks.on('thickWalls') and the pool holds under SHIELD, courier/vessel/damage.js)
thickWalls.number: the last 35 Lachryma of the pool marked

perfectPitch.name: Perfect Pitch
perfectPitch.does: Sounds a crystal's target note once more before you strike
perfectPitch.number: one more reference, a beat before the strike

heldBreath.name: Held Breath
heldBreath.does: Holds a blow's parry window a beat longer
heldBreath.switch: courier/parry.js (BLOW_WINDOW, and the outline glint with it)

ruleOfThirds.name: Rule of Thirds
ruleOfThirds.does: Shows the thirds in the Veritome's frame

halfTime.name: Half Time
halfTime.does: Swings the songbook's metronome on every other beat, never slower than the music
halfTime.number: ends on every other beat, a notch in the middle for the beat between

guideTone.name: Guide Tone
guideTone.does: Sounds the next charted note a beat early
guideTone.number: the note, quietly, a beat ahead

wetInk.name: Wet Ink
wetInk.does: Keeps Celestial mode waiting longer after your last stroke

paintStride.name: Paint Stride
paintStride.does: Your paint speeds you and refills your bottle. Other paint slows you.
paintStride.switch: tools/soulbrush/load.js strideOf (built: LACHRYMA-LOOP.md 5, rule 1; Super Mario Sunshine: water underfoot)
paintStride.number: own feeling x1.25, another x0.75, the bottle refilled 6 a second

ariadnesThread.name: Ariadne's Thread
ariadnesThread.does: Shows on the map the way back to the last Shrine you rested at
ariadnesThread.number: a thread from you to the Shrine

houseWhisper.name: Inside Tip
houseWhisper.does: Raku's whisper: marks the move the house would make at his tables (always shown when you practise)
houseWhisper.switch: world/bazaar/session.js coach() ({ suggest }: the house bot's choice, coach/index.js hint)
houseWhisper.number: a gold mark on one choice

wideSights.name: Wide Sights
wideSights.does: On a crossing, your sights find a foe further from the reticle, and the lock-on reaches wider
wideSights.switch: courier/ship/ship.js (the aim's foe snap, max(0.8, radius), and lock.reach 0.14: Petra's)
wideSights.number: the snap x1.75, the lock-on reach x1.5

biteSense.name: Bite Sense
biteSense.does: Holds the hook's window a third longer when a fish takes the lure
biteSense.switch: tools/sondelass/angling/angler.js (the bite's window: f.window x1.3 while game.knacks.on('biteSense'), the !!! held with it: Petra's)

autoCook.name: Auto-Cook
autoCook.does: Cooks a dish you know with no minigame, one grade below your best for it
autoCook.switch: world/garden/kitchen.js (the choose page's AUTO-COOK button, built: shown while game.knacks.on('autoCook') and progress/cooking/batch.js autoCookOf(dish, game.ledger) gives a grade)
autoCook.number: one grade below the dish's best (hi cook.best.<dish>), never above PERFECT, never dubious; for a dish cooked 5 times or once TRUE

thermometer.name: Thermometer
thermometer.does: Shows a cooking move's value as a number, and its heart, beside the food's own tells
thermometer.switch: world/garden/kitchen.js (the cooking window: the move's value 0..1 on its unit and the heart's mark beside the tells, while game.knacks.on('thermometer'): Petra's)
thermometer.number: the value and its heart shown

twoTone.name: Two-Tone
twoTone.does: Shows an agate's two feelings on a creature's body as two marbled bands, each in its own colour
twoTone.switch: vfx/agatelook.js (Calissa's: both colours marbled over the body as two veins, shown while game.knacks.on('twoTone'))
twoTone.number: two bands, the strongest feeling and the second
